blocking_status.unblock_requires: 把 results.confirmed_at 一类的真实来源观测时点带到 TeamMatchHistory 上，需改 src/w2/features/ 与 src/w2/prematch/，两者均不在 A0 授权范围内。

evidence_time_note: 四因子不再一视同仁。F3 用事件时点、F9 用来源快照时点，两者可用 observed_at；F5/F6 是结果派生，必须由调用方显式传入真实来源观测时点，且传入值等于 kickoff 会被识别并拒绝。缺数据的因子仍用 FeatureContext.as_of 并标注 SOURCE_QUERIED_AT_AS_OF，但参与计分的因子永远不能用它顶替。
factor_version_note: No factor builder emits a version. The recorder therefore requires the caller to supply one per factor and refuses the batch when it is absent; it does not invent one. Wiring a real version source belongs to F1R-B, not A0.

factors.ACTUAL_APPLIED_WEIGHT_FIELD: w2.pricing.team_score.independent_team_scores_from_contributions() -> scoring_factors[factor_id]['weight']；与 FeatureContribution.weight 不一致即拒绝整批
factors.EVIDENCE_TIME_SOURCE: FeatureContribution.observed_at = max(主/客最近一场 kickoff_at)。F3 只读开球间隔，不读任何结果字段，'某场比赛在 T 开球'在 T 即可观察，因此事件时点成立。
factors.PARTICIPATION_AUTHORITY: 同上权威的 scoring_factors 成员资格；READY 但被排除 → FACTOR_ADMISSION_FAILED

factors.ACTUAL_APPLIED_WEIGHT_FIELD: w2.pricing.team_score.independent_team_scores_from_contributions() -> scoring_factors[factor_id]['weight']；与 FeatureContribution.weight 不一致即拒绝整批
factors.EVIDENCE_TIME_SOURCE: F5 读已结算 AH 结果。TeamMatchHistory.observed_at 的实现是 return self.kickoff_at，开球时结算结果尚不存在。results.confirmed_at 在库中存在但从未被带到该对象上，TeamMatchHistory 也没有承载它的字段。记录器因此要求调用方显式传入来源观测时点，缺失或等于 kickoff 一律拒绝整批。
factors.PARTICIPATION_AUTHORITY: 同上权威的 scoring_factors 成员资格；READY 但被排除 → FACTOR_ADMISSION_FAILED

factors.ACTUAL_APPLIED_WEIGHT_FIELD: w2.pricing.team_score.independent_team_scores_from_contributions() -> scoring_factors[factor_id]['weight']；与 FeatureContribution.weight 不一致即拒绝整批
factors.EVIDENCE_TIME_SOURCE: F6 读历史进球。同上：observed_at 即 kickoff_at，进球结果在开球时不存在。
factors.PARTICIPATION_AUTHORITY: 同上权威的 scoring_factors 成员资格；READY 但被排除 → FACTOR_ADMISSION_FAILED

factors.ACTUAL_APPLIED_WEIGHT_FIELD: w2.pricing.team_score.independent_team_scores_from_contributions() -> scoring_factors[factor_id]['weight']；与 FeatureContribution.weight 不一致即拒绝整批
factors.EVIDENCE_TIME_SOURCE: FeatureContribution.observed_at = max(主/客 TeamXgSnapshot.observed_at)，是来源自带的真实抓取时点，与 kickoff 无关。
factors.PARTICIPATION_AUTHORITY: 同上权威的 scoring_factors 成员资格；READY 但被排除 → FACTOR_ADMISSION_FAILED

note: Located read-only in the current source. Every field names a real attribute of the live FeatureContribution the evaluation produces; nothing is a registry default or a file timestamp.
weight_note: applied_weight 取自 team_score 评分权威实际累加进 weight_sum_used 的那个值，不是 FeatureContribution.weight 的盲取，也不是注册表默认值（注册表无数值权重）。两者不一致即拒绝整批。
